content:
Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the central angle of the upper semicircle is \(180^\circ\).

The shaded sector excludes the \(40^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\) angles, so its central angle is
\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-30^\circ=110^\circ.
\]

The probability equals the ratio of the shaded sector’s area to the area of the entire disk:
\[
P=\frac{\frac{110}{360}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac{110}{360}
=\frac{11}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{11}{36}}
\]
